description: Subtle breathing/blink idle loop for a single character image. Preserves design at low denoise; loop is closed via AnimateDiff closed_loop plus an optional post-process ping-pong.
positive: subtle natural idle animation, gentle breathing, slow blinking, tiny head and cloth motion, character stays still in place, exact same character design, same clothing, same colors, same facial features
negative: deformation, extra limbs, extra fingers, changing clothes, color shift, morphing, identity change, camera movement, camera zoom, new accessories, new objects, background changes, text, watermark, logo, exaggerated motion, blurry, low quality
